name: find a short chain of sums reaching the exponent, one multiplication per link
mechanism: search for a sequence starting at one in which every element is the sum of two earlier elements and the last is the exponent; each link then costs one multiplication of already-computed powers, so a short chain gives a minimal-multiplication power

sources.ref: List of algorithms (revid 1373672109), entry 'Addition-chain exponentiation' in section Computational mathematics / Numerical algorithms / Elementary and special functions: exponentiation by positive integer powers that requires a minimal number of multiplications

requires: a fixed exponent worth optimising for
fails_when: finding the shortest chain is hard; heuristics give near-minimal chains
